$comment: Google Sheets connection. spreadsheetUrl = the sheet shared as 'Anyone with the link can view' (read via Google's CSV export); or use publishedUrl for a 'Publish to web' link. tabs maps each website tab to its gid (the number after #gid= in the sheet URL). Print this block from the sheet with CHIPKU ▸ Show website sheet config. The CHIPKU_SHEETS_CONFIG environment variable (same JSON) overrides this file; set it to {} to build the demo catalogue instead.
